what: Where the Protected Green class sits on the 2026 sheet, and what it reads on satellite today, recorded so that it can be compared in a few years.
not_a_finding: This is a baseline. Newly planted saplings do not move a vegetation index for two to three years, so nothing here can say whether planting has happened or worked.
not_miyawaki: Protected Green is a plan class covering 85 sq km on the sheet. It did not exist in the 2021 draft. It is probably a superset of the 20 announced Miyawaki plantations and must not be described as those zones. No site here is identified as a Miyawaki plot.
